label: For "Polygenic Risk Scoring": Combine genome-wide variant effects into calibrated disease risk scores that are valid across ancestries and actionable for prevention programmes. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Validating in the same biobank used for GWAS.
